visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot displays a spoon lifting a portion of smooth, pale yellow steamed egg topped with small, cooked clams and chopped green onions. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the soft texture of the egg. (2) The scene shifts to a top-down view of a pot of boiling water on a stove where a hand adds dried bonito flakes from a small glass bowl. Text overlays specify the ingredients. (3) A hand uses a metal whisk to stir the boiling flakes in the water within a dark frying pan. (4) The hot liquid is strained through a fine-mesh metal sieve into a large glass bowl, releasing steam. (5) In a clear glass bowl, eight vibrant yellow egg yolks are shown with salt and white pepper added. A metal whisk rests in the bowl. (6) A hand briskly whisks the eggs until they are well combined and frothy. (7) Cooled stock is poured into the whisked eggs and stirred further to create a uniform mixture. (8) The egg mixture is strained through a sieve into a clean white ceramic bowl to ensure a smooth consistency. (9) The bowl is placed on a metal rack inside a white pan, and a lid is placed on top, propped slightly open with a small gap for steam to escape. (10) A male chef in a white uniform with black trim stands in a bright kitchen studio, gesturing with his hands as he explains the cooking process. (11) Sliced mushrooms are added to a pan with a small amount of oil, followed by whole clams in their shells, rice wine, and water. (12) After cooking, the clam meat is removed from shells and returned to the pan with seasonings like soy sauce and sesame oil. Cornstarch water is added to thicken the sauce. (13) The thickened clam and mushroom sauce, garnished with green onions, is poured over the freshly steamed egg in the white bowl. (14) The final dish is presented in a close-up, showing the glossy sauce and ingredients resting on the smooth egg surface.
